verdict.rationale: Vestd is an equity-management SaaS, so a natural-language command interface or AI assistant is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only click-based workflows: issuing shares, data rooms, EMI schemes and HRIS integration. The llms.txt probe shows content published for LLMs to read, not a way to operate the product through natural-language commands, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
